text_block_list.text:
On the way back from hanging out with 
Daitaku Helios, her phone rang yet again.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, my pal just dropped some event info! 
Big thanks, always~~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...A festival at FreeSta? That's hype! 
They got event races and everything!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You're coming too, right, Trainy-P?

I gotta make sure I don't drag her down 
this time, so Daitaku Helios can have a 
blast...!

We arrived at the venue where freestyle 
races are normally held. It looks like 
various events are taking place today.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
DanBat over here!? Beach volley over 
there!? Whoa~, where should I start?!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy! We're doin' like a three-legged race 
or somethin'! Winner gets a gift card! 
Step up if you wanna run, let's gooo!!" 
his/her}, {"id": 6, "en": "Ayyy! Check out 
this Insta-spot~â Snappin' a pic in 
matchin' fits is guaranteed aesthetic!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real? Free prizes makes this event 
god-tier~!

It must be an appealing prize to her. 
...If Daitaku Helios runs seriously, she 
might just win.
choice_data_list:
Why don't you invite someone and enter 
together?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Alright, Trainer, get ready! 
Let's get hyped~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright, strings tied super tight! Let's 
be besties 4ever, 'kay?

Swept up in Daitaku Helios's momentum, I 
ended up entering the three-legged race. 
Was it really alright for her not to 
invite another Umamusume...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Duo
text_block_list.text:
Yarirafee! I'm gonna prove just how strong 
we are!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The vibes are totally on fire! We gotta 
give it our all too!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Alright, two laps around the track, 
please~! ...Ready, yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pump it up from the right leg! 1, 2, peep☆ 
Peep☆ 1, 2, peep☆ Peep☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait, my balance is totally wrecked?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaaaaat!?

Failing to match their rhythm, they fell 
over. Untying the strap around their legs, 
they decided to reset their stance and try 
again...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! That was a spectacular wipeout! 
Trai-poyo, are you okay-poyo~?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Duo
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright, make way, make way~~! 
We're the absolute best, no contest~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hardcore tryhards! We're like a 
whole lap behind, ROFL!☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
From here, it's max hype or nothing! We 
got this, right, Trainer?!

Though full of enthusiasm, the cycle of 
falling down and getting back up again 
remained unchanged.

In the end, far from contending for the 
win, she crossed the line dead last by a 
wide margin...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha~! That's hilarious! Giving way 
during a race is pretty rare!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, we fell down and STILL crossed the 
finish line? That's insane! We're like, 
totally gifted~! Ayyy-yeaaahhh!!
choice_data_list: Still... you wanted to win, didn't you?
Still... you wanted to win, didn't you?

text_block_list.text:
I dragged her down again this time... I 
really should have let Daitaku Helios 
partner with another Umamusume after 
all...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hanya? Winning? I'm not aiming for that 
though?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to make a splash with you, 
Trainy-P! That's all!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No way, lol! I'm legit dying of 
laughter~~♪ Picking you as my Trainer was 
definitely the right move!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: When I'm with Trainy-P, I'm soaring!

"I thought I was just holding them back. 
...But it seems they actually enjoyed 
having me along...!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, crap! There are other places to 
hang out too! Let's wrap this up before we 
run outta time☆
choice_data_list: Then, why don't we try beach volleyball?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, crap! There are other places to 
hang out too! Let's wrap this up before we 
run outta time☆
choice_data_list: Then, why don't we try beach volleyball?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright, how 'bout a dance battle? A BBQ 
is totally on the table too, right!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, choosing is impossible♪ We've just 
gotta visit every single one!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally!! Time to get serious☆ Ayyy 
lmao~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yay, yaaay~! The beeeest!!

We enjoyed the event to the fullest until 
sundown. Daitaku Helios seemed to have had 
so much fun that her excitement was 
completely off the charts!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thanks for the "thank you"☆ Feelin' 
super happy and totally ok-maru~~!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Duo
text_block_list.text:
Wheee~~! Things are getting pretty hype, 
huh?! Keep the energy up, pump it up~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy ayyy♪ Jump in on it all together!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Everyone got their glasses ready? 
Cheeeers!!

"Daitaku Helios naturally sweeps up the 
crowd and pumps up the atmosphere. It 
turned into an event filled with endless 
smiles!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Roger that! Let's go tear it up on that 
beach volleyball court!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! We're joining in! We're the 
strongest, so let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trainy-P! Here comes a spike!! Block it 
for me, pretty please!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Face guard god! Leave the cover to meee!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! Nailed it, let's gooo! Turnabout 
comeback starts right now!

Afterward, though we narrowly lost the 
match, Daitaku Helios was smiling the 
entire time. Seeing her have so much fun 
was the best part!
